notes.title: Cats and Sokoban - Mimi's Scratcher is here. Play it now!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce our new release:[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/2c99195f7b3176193c4fdf25826de2da2b1fe7fd.png[/img]

Cats and SokoBan – Mimi’s Scratcher is a sokoban type game in which you can push boxes, stack boxes and even jump between platforms, when necessary, so that Mimi the cat can reach her scratching post and have fun.
Look the level carefully, there is no time limit, no resources to manage, so you can calmly focus on solving the challenges.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/6ad9e5774fefbe7dbfbd46aa7e47bc29070d1129.png[/img]

Our team loved making this game. Mimi is a cat owned by one of the staff members, she is very cute.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 50 handcrafted levels.
[*] Stack boxes.
[*] Catchy soundtrack.
[*] Jump between platforms, like a good cat would.
[*] Minimalist interface and gameplay.
[*] 12 backgrounds for you to choose which is pleasant;
[*] Restart level.
[*] Fun and sweet sokoban with relaxing.
[*] Mimi, the cutest one that will warm your heart ♥
[/list]

You can get it now at a good discount and play it for many hours:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222770/Cats_and_Sokoban__Mimis_Scratcher/

notes.title: New Game release!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our new release:

[b]Invisible Places - Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle[/b]

This new game is a spiritual successor to our first Jigsaw puzzle.
This new game had 2 goals:
[list]
[*] Honor the family of one of our team members.
[*] Increase our contact with our followers.
[/list]

The first objective was successfully accomplished!
The second, we want to hear your opinion! In all of our games there are tabs in the Community Center so you can tell us about bugs, issues or recommendations.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807500/Invisible_Places__Pixel_Art_Jigsaw_Puzzle/

Thanks for your attention <3

notes.title: Fix Bugs part II
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

How are you doing?

Wooww... A long time has passed since our last talk here, and we are bringing a few bug fixes, so, let's see what we've done.

[list]
[*][b]Missions System - [/b]We had a problem that allowed the player to take the same mission more than once, making it impossible to finish the game, when the player passes close to the cards containing those missions.

[*][b]Save Game - [/b]Since the mission system was in error, consequently, the save did not work.

[*][b]Boat Itens = [/b]some items from the boat were not being collected.
[/list]


Don't think that we live just to fix bugs. We also made some improvements. =D

We put a few different sounds for the enemies and we also slightly modified the AI ​​of the enemies as well.

That's all, folks. We are very grateful for the support of everyone who purchased our game and I already say something. We will have news. Wait...

notes.title: Fix Bugs
notes.content:
This is our first experience with game in steam, and we are so glad to know that this community help us to get our game better. It's a honor to hear all of you, that bought our game, played and gave us feedbacks. We are trying don't disapoint you, making your gameplay better.

Thank you so much.

Our players have reported the following bugs to us:

[list]
[*] [b]Save Game[/b] - We think you all had this problem. You saved the game and when you were going to load it, there was no save file. Our fault. We forgot to put some parameters in this function and now it has been fixed.

[*] [b]Quests[/b] - After the first quest completed (finding the backpack), the main quest of the game (leaving the fucking island) was not appearing to the player. This has already been fixed.

[*] [b]Lamp[/b] - Some players saw that the lamp goes out before the expected time and even combining it with oil, the flame did not return. Both bugs fixed.

[*] [b]Torches[/b] - Almost all of them were out of position, as if they were floating, which even gave a very cool effect since the island seems to be supernatural, but no ... It was a bug and it was fixed too.

[*] [b]Menu[/b] - This was a bug that almost went unnoticed. When "Play Horror" was clicked twice quickly, a black screen appeared and the game did not start. A very special thanks to you who found this bug. I don't think we would ever find that out, since we only clicked "Play Horror" once in our tests.
[/list]

This is all for now.

Once again we thank you all and please keep playing and sending feedback, as this helps us a lot. And you know, if you find any other bug, do not think twice, report it.


Att.
Gamix Team
